fullData.title: Guess and Measure with Cubes!
fullData.description: Practice estimating how long everyday objects are using cubes before you measure them!

challenges.instruction: Look at the pencil. How many cubes long do you think it is? Make your guess, then place your cubes to find out!
challenges.hint: Count each cube carefully as you place them right next to the pencil.
challenges.narration: Let's look at this pencil. Can you guess how many cubes long it is before we measure?

challenges.instruction: Here is a crayon! Take a guess at how many cubes will fit along its length, then test it out.
challenges.hint: Start your cubes right at the very beginning of the crayon and line them up straight.
challenges.narration: Time for the crayon! Make your best guess on how many cubes it will take.

challenges.instruction: Look at this fun marker! Guess how many cubes long it is, and then tile the cubes to check.
challenges.hint: Check if your estimate was close by filling the space from start to end.
challenges.narration: Here is a marker. How many cubes do you think fit inside its length? Let's find out!
